verdict.rationale: Rollbar's first-party docs describe Resolve, an AI agent that takes a production error and produces a pull request for review (rollbar-docs-17). The homepage says it writes a tested fix and opens the PR for the user to approve (rollbar-docs-48), which covers drafting the fix, opening the PR and human review. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on repo provider support and setup, details on how fixes are tested, and independent or hands-on corroboration that Resolve works as claimed.
